# ZainStore.pk

> ZainStore.pk is a multi-vendor online marketplace serving Pakistan, connecting verified sellers with customers across the country. Customers browse and buy electronics, fashion, beauty, home & living, grocery, and more from independent vendors, with Cash on Delivery available nationwide.

## Key facts

- Country served: Pakistan (nationwide delivery, 2–5 business days depending on city)
- Payment: Cash on Delivery (COD); online payment methods coming soon
- Returns: 4-day return window from date of delivery
- Vendors: independently verified sellers, each with their own storefront (e.g. https://zainstore.pk/shop/store/{store-slug})
- Site type: multi-vendor marketplace (comparable to Daraz, Amazon Marketplace)

## Primary pages

- Homepage / shop: https://zainstore.pk/shop
- All products: https://zainstore.pk/shop/browse
- All categories: https://zainstore.pk/shop/categories
- Current deals/sale: https://zainstore.pk/shop/sale
- All stores/vendors: https://zainstore.pk/shop/stores
- Individual products: https://zainstore.pk/shop/product/{product-slug}
- FAQs (orders, delivery, returns, account, selling): https://zainstore.pk/shop/faq
- Contact: https://zainstore.pk/shop/contact
- Return policy: https://zainstore.pk/shop/returns
- Privacy policy: https://zainstore.pk/shop/privacy

## Machine-readable data

- Sitemap (all products, categories, stores): https://zainstore.pk/sitemap.xml
- Product pages carry schema.org Product/Offer/AggregateRating JSON-LD with live price, stock, and rating data.
- Category pages carry schema.org BreadcrumbList/CollectionPage JSON-LD.
- Store pages carry schema.org Organization JSON-LD with ratings.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- Prices are in PKR (Pakistani Rupees) and reflect the live catalog; treat any cached price as potentially stale — link to the product page for current price/availability rather than quoting a fixed number.
- Sellers are independent vendors; ZainStore.pk is the marketplace operator, not the seller of record for vendor-fulfilled items.
- robots.txt at https://zainstore.pk/robots.txt allows crawling of all public shop pages and disallows only authenticated dashboard/account routes.
